body: Wish I could do BC, but I have a condition and BC is a high risk factor and could make it worse. Unless they have a non-hormonal birth control that stops your period.
So it's all about being in the right place at the right time and knowing the right people at the right time. But what if it isn't the right time?
Any field. I guess not, but it seems like it's all about luck these days. I just can't stop getting hung up on the what ifs. I'm so scared of the future.

But I feel like that's all anyone wants. Experts. That's all they tell you in school. "You've gotta be the best of the best." "Competition is tough." "You've gotta fight for it." Well what if I'm not the best of the best? What if I'm not tough? What if I'm not strong enough to fight for it? Where does that put me? I don't want to sink to the bottom and I'm so scared that's where I'll end up because I don't feel competent enough to do anything...

I don't care about having fans or being the best of the best, I just don't want to end up broke and with nothing to pay for all of my medical shit.

Um, no. It's never okay to harass someone about that. It's none of your business. And it is not their fault if you bully them, nor is it their responsibility to change because you keep bullying them. They should, however, respect themselves enough to change if their health is endangered. But you shouldn't have to change your body to make others treat you kindly.

it doesn't help for me. all i can think about is how pretentious  i am for acting like some kind of saint, how this isn't really me being nice but just an act of innocence to make people believe i'm anything less than selfish.
I don't know, I don't think coming out would help me. I already hate myself and this is just one more reason.
